description:
Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Bank Partner Program Management to help lead the day-to-day execution and ongoing management of Oportun’s bank partner programs. You’ll serve as a key point of coordination between Oportun and our bank partners, helping drive timely approvals, resolve issues, manage reporting and obligations, and keep critical cross-functional initiatives moving forward.

This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Risk, Finance, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and Technology. You’ll bring strong program management, consumer lending knowledge, regulatory awareness, and partner management skills to help strengthen our bank partnerships while supporting growth and a strong member experience.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

  • You’ll manage the bank approval process for cross-functional initiatives, including organizing documentation, coordinating reviews, tracking approvals, maintaining records, and escalating delays or risks.
  • You’ll serve as a key point of contact for day-to-day bank partner requests, priorities, and deliverables.
  • You’ll manage issue resolution across Oportun and bank partners, including intake, investigation, escalation, root-cause tracking, resolution, and stakeholder communication.
  • You’ll coordinate responses to ad hoc requests from bank partners and internal teams, ensuring inputs, owners, deadlines, and deliverables remain clear.
  • You’ll prepare, validate, and deliver recurring bank partner reporting with a strong focus on accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
  • You’ll track partner obligations, commitments, open items, and required follow-up through completion.
  • You’ll identify process gaps, recurring issues, control weaknesses, and opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and the overall partner experience.
  • You’ll partner closely with Product, Risk, Finance, Operations, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, and Technology teams to resolve issues and support partner needs.
  • You’ll provide clear updates to senior leadership on approval progress, material issues, reporting status, operational risks, and emerging trends.
  • You’ll support regulatory reviews, partner oversight activities, and other governance processes as needed.
  • You’ll help improve program management processes, controls, documentation, and reporting to create greater consistency and visibility.
  • You’ll use data, automation, and AI tools thoughtfully to improve reporting, tracking, documentation, issue management, and workflow efficiency.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re a highly organized and proactive program leader who knows how to keep complex work moving across multiple teams and external partners. You’re comfortable managing competing priorities, working through ambiguity, and escalating risks when needed.

You understand consumer lending operations and the regulatory environment well enough to recognize where issues, approvals, or control gaps require deeper attention. You communicate clearly, build trust with partners, and know how to balance urgency with accuracy and sound judgment.

You also take ownership. You follow through on commitments, keep stakeholders informed, and look for ways to improve how work gets done.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

  • Significant experience in consumer lending, banking, fintech, or a related financial services environment.
  • Strong understanding of the consumer lending lifecycle, including acquisition, servicing, payments, collections, and recoveries.
  • Experience managing external partners, bank relationships, strategic programs, or complex cross-functional initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of lending operations, regulatory compliance, operational risk, and controls.
  • Experience supporting regulatory reviews, audits, partner oversight, or similar governance activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate discrepancies, identify root causes, and drive issues through resolution.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, stakeholders, and deliverables with limited oversight.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with operational teams, senior leaders, and external partners.
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders and build strong working relationships across internal and external teams.
  • Strong attention to detail and a consistent focus on accuracy, documentation, and follow-through.
  • Proficiency with Excel and reporting, workflow, or data-management tools.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with high-priority and time-sensitive work.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience managing bank partner programs or sponsor bank relationships.
  • Experience with bank approval processes, partner reporting, covenant or obligation tracking, or issue-management frameworks.
  • Experience working across Product, Marketing, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Finance, and Technology.
  • Experience with consumer credit regulatory requirements and bank oversight expectations.
  • Experience building or improving operational controls, reporting processes, or governance frameworks.
  • Experience using AI, automation, or coding tools to improve reporting, analysis, documentation, or workflow efficiency.

Compensation

The US salary range for this full-time position is $ 148,100 - $ 237,000

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects a national minimum and maximum range for new hire salaries for this position.

Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range that meets your criteria during the hiring process.

Please note that the compensation range listed in this posting reflects only the base salary for this position and does not include other compensation elements or benefits. R1 #LI-REMOTE #LI-RR1

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:

US Benefits:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) including company match
  • Flexible PTO and Parental Leave
  • Company-paid Life & Disability Insurance

Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers
